test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate title for the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is Ghana - land of gold.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Refer to the second line of the passage: The reason why we are saying this is that most African states lived in tribal villages but Ghana was the centre of gold trade.
 
• The passage also mentions that 'Arab traders in the 9th century described Ghana as 'the land of gold.'
 
• Last paragraph of the passage mentions that 'Ghana had reached its peak in the 10th century. This was the country which controlled both the gold and salt trades'.
 
• Hence we can conclude that 'Ghana- land of gold' is the **most appropriate title** for the given passage.
 
• Thus option 1 is the correct answer.
